findings.summary: Rejected candidate c182b51de03aa512ca82ae9aa823b42df6cbb676 reused legacy proof progress state and allowed the HTTP client to follow redirects. The accepted candidate uses new one-use marker keys without reading or overwriting legacy state, and the claimed shared Speech adapter explicitly disables redirects.

Exact candidate 69af03350e272a70c7a539d08d5161a7c1f2da5f at base ee4994b91bfb0255637d53204d895943dc996195 passed independent review with no actionable findings. The reviewer reproduced 96 passing tests and 11 passing subtests, confirmed a hostile 307 yields one POST then fail-closed speech_failed, and confirmed scheduled Speech parameters remain empty by default. No Azure query, mutation, audio generation, pipeline run, paid call, deployment, push, or PR action occurred during review.
